title: MarketingForm - Data API
description: Represents an Account Engagement marketing form that has been synched to Salesforce. Use forms on your website and landing pages to collect information about visitors and turn anonymous visitors into identified prospects. This object is available in API version 42.0 and later.

CampaignId.description: The ID of the related campaign.

ErrorRate.description: The percentage of views that led to an error.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp that indicates when the current user last viewed a record that is related to this form.

LastViewedDate.description: The date and time when the current user last viewed this record. If this value is null, this record might only have been referenced (see LastReferencedDate) and not viewed.

Name.description: The name of the marketing form.

SubmissionRate.description: The percentage of the views that led to a form submission.

TotalErrors.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort
TotalErrors.description: The total number of times a form error prevented a submission.

TotalSubmissions.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort
TotalSubmissions.description: The total number of times the form was successfully submitted.

TotalTrackedLinkClicks.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort
TotalTrackedLinkClicks.description: The total number of link clicks from your thank you page.

TotalViews.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort
TotalViews.description: The total number of times your form has been viewed. Includes multiple views from the same visitor.

Type.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort
Type.description: Specifies the type of marketing form record, either a form or form handler.

UniqueErrors.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort
UniqueErrors.description: The number of errors generated by separate visitors.

UniqueSubmissions.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort
UniqueSubmissions.description: The total number of unique submissions. Removes multiple submissions from the same prospect.

UniqueTrackedLinkClicks.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort
UniqueTrackedLinkClicks.description: The total number of unique link clicks from your thank you page. Removes multiple clicks from the same prospect.

UniqueViews.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort
UniqueViews.description: The number of form views by separate visitors.

special_access_rules: To access this object, your org must use Account Engagement and users need the CRM User or Sales User permission set.
associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. If the API version isn’t specified, they’re available in the same API versions as this object. Otherwise, they’re available in the specified API version and later.

- **MarketingFormEvent (API version 44.0)**: Change events are available for the object.
- **MarketingFormFeed**: Feed tracking is available for the object.
